daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query with window functions to calculate: (1) the 20-day moving average for each stock, (2) the rank of stocks by daily percentage gain within each date partition, and (3) identify stocks where today's close price exceeds the 20-day moving average. Use ROW_NUMBER() or RANK() to find top 5 gainers per trading day. Return stock symbol, date, close price, 20-day MA, daily % change, and rank. Filter for dates in Q3 2024 only.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Incident Classification
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data (contains incident reports with missing values, inconsistent formatting, and duplicate records). Clean the dataset by: (1) handling missing values in severity and crash type columns using appropriate imputation, (2) standardising suburb names to title case and removing leading/trailing whitespace, (3) converting date columns to datetime format, (4) removing exact duplicate rows, (5) creating a new 'crash_category' column that classifies crashes as 'Fatal', 'Serious Injury', 'Other Injury', or 'Non-Injury' based on severity column. Export the cleaned dataset to a CSV file. Provide a summary report showing row count before/after cleaning and missing value percentages per column.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production ETL: Database Population & Trend Analysis
daily_quests.description: Build a Python script that: (1) extracts wine production data from the Australian wine production statistics dataset (vintage year, region, variety, production volume in litres), (2) cleans and validates the data (remove nulls, standardise region names, convert volumes to consistent units), (3) creates a SQLite database with a 'wine_production' table, and (4) loads the cleaned data into the table. Then, write SQL queries to: (a) calculate the total production volume by region and vintage year using GROUP BY and ORDER BY, (b) use a CTE to identify regions where production volume increased year-over-year, (c) rank wine varieties by total production across all years using ROW_NUMBER(). Return the top 5 regions by total production and top 10 varieties by volume. Document your ETL pipeline steps in comments.
